title: Seel's Horn Is an Emergency Snorkel
premise: Seel hunts beneath ice, then uses its hard head horn to punch a breathing hole.
audiencePromise: See how Seel's ice-bashing horn becomes a way to breathe beneath frozen seas.
openLoop: How does Seel breathe while hunting beneath sheets of ice?
payoff: Seel uses its hard head horn to punch through ice when it needs to breathe.
engagementQuestion: Is Seel's horn mainly an ice-breaker or a breathing tool?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and clearly. Stress under ice, hard horn, and breathing hole. Pause before the final choice.

scenes.headline: IT PUNCHES THROUGH ICE
scenes.narration: Seel hunts under ice. Then its horn punches through.
scenes.caption: UNDER ICE, THEN THROUGH IT

scenes.headline: HUNTING UNDER ICE
scenes.narration: Under ice, Seel hunts for prey in frigid seas.
scenes.caption: SEEL HUNTS BELOW THE ICE

scenes.headline: BUILT TO BASH THICK ICE
scenes.narration: Its head horn is very hard, built for bashing through thick ice.
scenes.caption: A HARD HORN FOR THICK ICE

scenes.headline: A HOLE FOR AIR
scenes.narration: When it needs to breathe, Seel punches a hole through the ice.
scenes.caption: NEEDS TO BREATHE? PUNCH THROUGH ICE

scenes.headline: TWO JOBS IN THE ICE
scenes.narration: The same horn that breaks thick ice makes Seel's breathing hole.
scenes.caption: ICE-BASHING HORN, BREATHING HOLE
